justification: Fix two reported brief bugs + two empty-state bugs (frontend display): (1) a Data sources footer aggregating every source from the streamed sections — restores the 'data sources at the bottom' and delivers the 'every figure traced to its source' promise; (2) a satellite section that comes back empty when satellite WAS requested now reads 'No result', not the misleading 'tick Include satellite analysis'; (3) SEPP Housing with no standards (e.g. a commercial zone) says 'don't apply to this zone' instead of 'No data fields'; (4) the PostGIS heritage dict renders as one sentence, not a raw 'HCA:…, Raw: 2 items' dump.

pre_impl.existing_data: Each streamed section is a DataField (or nested DataFields) carrying source + as_at; the backend tracks data_sources_used but never streams it and the page never rendered a sources list (git history confirms). describeUnavailable had no knowledge of whether satellite was requested. SEPP dispatch fell through to 'No data fields' when standards were empty. heritage_postgis is a {has_heritage,hca,items,raw} dict.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 'traced to its source' subtitle promised provenance the UI threw away; the satellite empty-state assumed not-available == box-unticked even when it WAS ticked; empty SEPP/heritage rendered as raw dumps.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data. collectSources walks the already-streamed sections client-side for distinct sources + URLs; ranWithSatellite captured at generate time threads through SectionCard/SectionData into describeUnavailable; SEPP/heritage get honest renders.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No new fetch. All helpers guard null/non-object and fall back (empty footer hidden; unknown source slug humanized generically).
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). New props are optional with defaults; tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: data-sources list absent; GF said 'tick the box' though satellite was on; SEPP 'No data fields'; heritage raw dump. After: a Data sources footer; GF says 'No result — satellite ran but returned nothing'; SEPP says it doesn't apply to the zone; heritage reads as a sentence.

functions.name: collectSources
functions.output: {sources:[{label,asAt}], links:[{label,url}]} — distinct data sources + legislation URLs, humanized
functions.if_none: returns empty arrays; the footer is hidden when both are empty

functions.name: describeUnavailable
functions.output: the empty-state label/detail/tone; a satellite section with satelliteRan=true returns 'No result', else 'tick the box'
functions.if_none: non-satellite sections keep the existing mapping; satelliteRan defaults false

values: N/A - no regulatory values; display-only provenance + empty-state mapping.
queries: N/A - no database or API query; sources are aggregated from data already on the client.

break_it.scenario: A satellite section is empty because the box was NOT ticked
break_it.repro: ranWithSatellite is false (captured at generate) so describeUnavailable returns the 'tick the box' message
break_it.how: the 'No result' branch only fires when satelliteRan is true

break_it.scenario: The user reruns without satellite after a satellite run
break_it.repro: ranWithSatellite is set at each handleGenerate from the current checkbox state
break_it.how: captured per-run at generate time, not read live

break_it.scenario: A section has no source field
break_it.what_happens: a blank/undefined source row could appear in the footer
break_it.repro: collectSources only records typeof source === 'string' && source
break_it.how: non-string/empty sources are skipped; an all-empty footer is hidden

break_it.what_happens: the new empty branch must not replace the real table
break_it.repro: the empty branch is the else of standards && standards.length
break_it.how: SeppHousingCard still renders whenever standards exist

break_it.scenario: heritage_postgis is null or not an object
break_it.repro: the special-case requires df.value to be a non-null non-array object; humanizeHeritage guards !v || !v.has_heritage
break_it.how: falls through to the normal render / 'No heritage listing' sentence

post_merge.other_repo: N/A - frontend deploys via Vercel. SEPARATE backend question: whether Granny Flat actually RAN on the Railway backend for this property (the frontend now reports the empty result honestly, but if GF is failing server-side that needs a live backend check).
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite ON: a Data sources footer lists the sources used; if Granny Flat returns nothing it says 'No result' not 'tick the box'. For a commercial zone, SEPP Housing says it doesn't apply. Heritage reads as a sentence, not a raw dump.
